IT IS NOT A LIVE CONFIRMATION OF WHAT MODEL SERVED THIS SESSION'S TOKENS.
inference.self_reported_resolved_model_id_source: GENUINE SELF-REPORT from THIS session's own runtime system context, which states verbatim: 'You are powered by the model named Opus 5 (1M context). The exact model ID is claude-opus-5[1m].' This is a self-report, not a third-party or cryptographic attestation. It was NOT obtained by running `python3 -m orchestration.adapter resolve --role validator`, whose output would be a live resolution of the committed policy -- a different fact from this session's own identity -- and which the task card's provenance_requirement forbids quoting as a live identity check of this session.
inference.self_reported_id_variant_note: The self-reported identifier carries the '[1m]' long-context variant suffix; the committed binding target is written without it. This session records its own string exactly as its runtime states it and does not normalize it to match the target. The base family (claude-opus-5) agrees with the committed target; the variant suffix is disclosed rather than silently dropped.
inference.conflation_forbidden_note: This receipt does NOT assert that the committed binding target describes this session, and does NOT assert that this session's self-report proves what the adapter would resolve if run. CORR-20260815-092c9f corrected exactly this conflation in the BATCH-86fd69 archive receipt for TASK-20260815-1f9a8e. The two facts are recorded here in separately labelled fields and are never written in place of one another.
inference.mismatch_disposition: The self-reported base family matches the committed binding target for review-adversarial (claude-opus-5). No fallback and no degradation was requested, selected, or performed by this task. The harness-wide SESSION-MODEL-PROVENANCE-GAP standing risk (DEC-20260815-23d3bd, DEC-20260815-d83212) still applies to the launch path in general: this session was not launched through `orchestration/adapter env`, so its identity rests on self-report alone and no probe confirms it.

It read only the Coordinator-committed snapshot 36bcb3f7e00f52847ecc380988b97171b56190a1 and immutable committed predecessor records, and re-derived every number and every field comparison itself.
independence.sibling_review_same_model_family_disclos: PLAINLY DISCLOSED, NOT MINIMIZED: the sibling Red Team review TASK-20260815-82a8cb runs CONCURRENTLY on the SAME MODEL FAMILY as this Validator (both bind to review-adversarial, whose committed anthropic target is claude-opus-5).
